Prices for the stay of Nov 7 to 9, 2026, as listed on October 3, 2026.

18 Paris hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on October 3, 2026 for Nov 7 to Nov 9, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Paris hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 3, 2026 snapshot, at 15 of the 18 Paris hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Vio.com at 4, the hotel's own site at 2, Agoda at 1, Billabook.com at 1, Bluepillow.com at 1, Booking.com at 1, br.Bluepillow.com at 1, Clicktrip.com at 1 and 3 other sites at 3 between them. These are the Paris rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 18 of the 18 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Billabook.com at 4, the hotel's own site at 3, Bluepillow.com at 2, Vio.com at 2, Agoda at 1, Booking.com at 1, br.Bluepillow.com at 1, Clicktrip.com at 1 and 5 other sites at 5 between them (a tie counts for each site). Taxes and fees at Paris hotels

At the 15 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 22% ($20 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 15% at Glint Paris to 31% at Novotel Paris Est. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
